paper_title: Searching for Ultralight Dark Matter Conversion in Solar Corona using Low Frequency Array Data
coupling_convention: epsilon x (rho_A'/rho_DM)^0.5, dimensionless kinetic mixing scaled by dark photon density fraction, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4
notes: New observed 95% C.L. limit on dark photon kinetic mixing from resonant DPDM-to-photon conversion in the solar corona, using 3x17-min LOFAR beam-formed observations (30-80 MHz). The paper states the limit reaches ~1e-13 across 30-80 MHz (mass range ~1.24e-7 to 3.31e-7 eV via m = 4.136e-15*f). Exact bin-by-bin values are only shown in Fig. 4 (with zig-zag structure spanning roughly 1e-14 to 1e-12); no numerical table is provided, so a flat representative ~1e-13 line over the validity range is emitted. The paper also derives a weaker axion-photon limit (Fig. 10) that does not exceed CAST/astrophysical bounds; the primary result is the dark photon constraint.
